fusions.name: Reaching Lash
fusions.desc: Snaps out an arm of water that deals 3 damage, then lashes 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 50% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Ink Spray
fusions.desc: Sprays a cone of ink 4 tiles long that deals 14 damage to everything in it and knocks each back 2 tiles, with a 40% chance to leave each [Hindered] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Jet Away
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 6 tiles away. For 4 seconds after, you move 20% faster.

fusions.name: Arms Everywhere
fusions.desc: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 8. The next ability you use spends them all: you move and attack 3% faster per stack (24% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 8 seconds.
